description: Shared fold-authority status fixture. The Rust daemon (crates/daemon/src/fold_authority.rs and crates/daemon/src/fold_authority_handler_tests.rs) asserts that session.status emits each segment below, and the TypeScript plugin (packages/opencode-plugin/src/shared/fold-authority-status.ts) asserts that it parses each segment and names each row's next step. Changing a daemon segment fails the Rust tests until this file changes, and changing this file fails the plugin tests until the parser still routes every row.

pending.segment: fold authority pending eidnara: another binding is open on this session
fold authority pending eidnara: the summarizer is busy or a publication is pending
pending.step: wait for the summarizer to finish, then restart this OpenCode instance

pending.segment: fold authority pending eidnara: it applies at the next bind while the session is quiescent
pending.step: keep other OpenCode instances on this session closed, then restart this one so it binds the session again

stalled_applied: eidnara, summarizer stalled (no models at the last pass)
